name: Chromium
description: CUP ECDSA-signs the protocol so updates authenticate even against a compromised TLS/CDN. Gold standard.
limitations: AI-generated static source analysis. Confirm the affected version, platform, update channel, and cited control flow before relying on this classification.

later_review_audit.description: Chromium's updater defaults enable CUP and CRX3 publisher-proof handling; the inspected Chromium source does not independently establish the CUP verification algorithm or an end-to-end compromised-CDN guarantee.
limitations: Newly retrieved default-branch snapshot, not the original study checkout; the inspected tree does not contain the delegated update-client CUP verification implementation or release-specific Chromium build configuration.
The source shows the Chromium updater framework and defaults, not that every Chromium-based product uses these defaults.
